analysis.title: Secure Monitoring Platform Requirements
analysis.summary: A secure monitoring platform shall collect system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from university servers and managed endpoints; it shall detect unusual login behavior, repeated failed authentication, suspicious process activity, and unauthorized configuration changes; security administrators shall be able to review alerts, investigate affected devices, record investigation notes, change alert status, and isolate compromised endpoints when necessary; the system shall maintain audit logs of security events and administrator actions and provide a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations.

assessments.explanation: The platform must collect system events, authentication activity, process information, and security alerts from university servers and managed endpoints.
The platform shall detect unusual login behavior, repeated failed authentication, suspicious process activity, and unauthorized configuration changes as defined threat indicators.
Security administrators must be able to review alerts, investigate affected devices, record investigation notes, change alert status, and isolate compromised endpoints when necessary.
The system shall maintain audit logs of security events and administrator actions and provide a centralized dashboard for monitoring security status across multiple campus locations.
